counts.organisms_explicit_in_audit_note: strings the upstream audit file states per loop; not a validated taxon mapping

execution_statement: No upstream code, Lean file or signature check was run by Frontier or this adapter. Every record states what upstream's files say.
fidelity_statement: Every MorphoEval score here describes how closely a script matches its cited source, as judged by a language model for the script's author. It says nothing about whether the source is right.

known_exclusions.audit_rule: A loop counts only if the paper is extracted (governing equations/parameters in the reference) AND the literature was actually scouted (OpenAlex + Wikimedia candidates). Template loops with synthetic RNG series do not count.
known_exclusions.frontier_policy: No imported record cites a Lean theorem as proof, and none counts a template equation.

lean_template_gate.problem_as_upstream_states_it: Overnight generators emit identical placeholder Lean theorems (a*b>0 by Int.mul_pos; p+q-q=p by omega; numeral>numeral by decide) while math_kg_loops specs register them as formalizing each loop's named governing law. Valid Lean, vacuous claims, ~3 KG equation entries per loop.

never_resurrected: template Lean theorems counted as proof
not_imported: Tier B (paper named only, no extracted equations/scouted literature): 992
every loop deleted upstream as Tier C: 8986 loops, 130452 files (manifest `applied`: True)
known_exclusions.read_level: full-text of the JSON files named; counts are upstream's own statements, not re-run
